# Stock Wide fixed String array fixture with keyed serialization metadata

Generated by `scripts/generate_public_fixed_string_array_fixture.sh` with
`FIXED_STRING_ARRAY_SERIALIZATION_VARIANT=keyed` and the pinned ClickHouse
26.7.1.1315 official build in a disposable local store. It uses the same
synthetic three-column data, Wide layout, LZ4 streams, plain `.mrk2` marks,
seven data marks, and short final mark as the sibling
`wide_array_fixed_string` fixture. Stock `CHECK TABLE` passed before capture.

This producer configuration records one `Default` serializer for `pk` in
`serialization.json`, with zero defaults and 13 rows. The file inventory,
stream bytes, and marks otherwise match the sibling fixture whose serializer
list is empty. `SHA256SUMS` pins every captured part file. This second stock
variant exists to keep keyed and unkeyed serialization metadata behavior
within the exact paired fixed String array schema under test.
